stages.name: near_terminal
stages.rationale: east legal approach boundary, nearly west-facing; nonterminal filter

stages.name: approach
stages.rationale: larger legal approach neighborhood and heading error

stages.name: east_turning
stages.rationale: east-side room for turns; broad vertical offset and heading error

stages.name: east_corners
stages.rationale: separate upper/lower corners require turning around wall envelope

stages.name: outer_corridors
stages.rationale: outside upper/lower U arms; eastward progress requires long travel

stages.name: west_exit
stages.rationale: west opening: direct eastward line hits closed wall; must select a detour

stages.name: u_interior
stages.rationale: U interior with full heading support: escape west before detouring

policy_information: goal-blind persistent random actions; no lookahead or action ranking
reset_information: goal region, obstacle geometry, turn radius, previous collection success/coverage
diagnostic_policy: after adaptive phase, fixed 1000 real steps per stage 1..6; no promotion from these data
rationale: 36k upper bound is 18% of old 200k; 30k adaptation plus fixed 6k failure/coverage survey; no budget extension
